title: I REMEMBER CALVARY
author: William C.Martin
stanzas: Where He may lead me I will go, For I have learned to trust Him so, And I remember 'twas for me That he was slain on Calvary.
O I delight in His command, Love to be led by His dear hand; His divine will is sweet to me, Hallowed by blood-stained Calvary.
Onward I go, nor doubt nor fear, Happy with Christ, my Savior, near, Trusting that I some day shall see Jesus, my Friend, of Calvary.
chorus: Jesus shall lead me night and day, Jesus shall lead me all the way, He is the truest Friend to me, For I remember Calvary.
